## Python environment

```{python}
import sys
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

print("Python:", sys.executable)
print("NumPy:", np.__version__)
print("Matplotlib:", matplotlib.__version__)
print("Backend:", matplotlib.get_backend())
```

## Sinusoid test

```{python}
#| label: fig-sine
#| fig-cap: "Test sinusoid generated with Python and Matplotlib"

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 500)
y = np.sin(x)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
ax.plot(x, y)
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("sin(x)")
ax.set_title("Quarto + Jupyter + Matplotlib")
ax.grid(True)

fig
```
